name: Tolbutamide

similar.name: Sulfacarbamide
problems: Pulled from the market in Germany, first in 1988 — for liver harm and blood problems

examples.title: A Drug Interaction Study of Tasisulam in Patients With Advanced Cancer or Lymphoma
examples.why: Terminated based on safety results from another trial

summary: Based on a small computer model rather than tests on people, Tolbutamide received a high risk score for liver harm and a low risk score for heart harm [M]. A similar drug named Sulfacarbamide was pulled from the market in Germany in 1988 due to blood problems and liver damage [3]. In addition, a clinical study involving Tolbutamide was stopped early because of safety results seen in a different trial [5].
